svg.title: Latch — Local infrastructure
svg.desc: Mac laptop → hardware-accelerated ARM64 Linux host → nested OpenStack VM

text.tspan: Mac laptop → hardware-accelerated ARM64 Linux host → nested OpenStack VM
6 CPUs · 8 GiB RAM · 80 GiB sparse disk
Grant commands use trusted Lima stdin.
Gateway ingress: 10.1.1.0/24 · Service management: 10.1.3.0/24 · Other service IPs are dynamic.
Ubuntu ARM64 / UEFI · 1 vCPU · 1 GiB RAM · 8 GB disk · OpenSSH trusts the OpenBao public CA.
Security group permits SSH only from Warpgate 100.64.10.10/32. No gateway agent runs inside the VM.
Outer Linux VM uses Apple VZ. Tenant uses KVM
after a successful probe; otherwise ARM64 QEMU/TCG.
Gateway has no default or direct tenant route.
Gateway host keys + recordings; OpenBao CA / Raft;
server grant database. Stop / start retains these.
